gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-esteban: Metamorphous has generous sidebearings and a high midline, giving it a stately, spaced-out look. Esteban follows in a serif with oversized lowercase, so body text at a slightly smaller size than the heading feels natural.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-faustina: Metamorphous leads with a high-set midline and a soft shift between fat and slim strokes, all of it commanding. Faustina, a text serif, backs it up with a wide-jawed c.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-halant: Stately and a little theatrical, Metamorphous spaces its letters generously and holds its midline high. And Halant, a classic serif, takes over where display stops, with a towering x-height and outward-pointing terminals.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-headland-one: Metamorphous earns its keep when it is big and brief, with roomy sidebearings and a high midline. But Headland One, a text serif, spaces its letters well apart and lets a rounded o nearly match its capital.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-hedvig-letters-se: Commanding from the first line, Metamorphous sets a high midline and soft fat-to-slim strokes up top. Hedvig Letters Serif sits beneath it with sturdy, tall lowercase and curves left open, so the two feel dignified and approachable at once.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-marcellus-sc: Metamorphous has a high-set midline and wide sidebearings. Marcellus SC brings a literary, dignified weight below it, its serif lowercase standing as tall as cast iron capitals.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-montagu-slab: Montagu Slab reads sturdy yet refined, with robust downstrokes and slender turns. Its large x-height holds up on screens at modest sizes, while Metamorphous above it supplies the commanding, widely spaced display voice.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-noto-serif-hentai: Grand and slightly strange, Metamorphous spaces its letters widely and lifts its midline high. Noto Serif Hentaigana, a serif, does the quieter work, with open-jawed curves and small letters nearly as tall as capitals.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-ovo: Authoritative from the first glance, Metamorphous shows off a high midline and a soft fat-to-slim stroke shift. Ovo, a classic serif, does its best work in the text, with a tall middle band and spacious curve endings.
gen-gf-offside-fs-erode: Expressive and wiry, Offside spreads its tracked letters out in curves that refuse to close. And Erode, a classic serif, settles in beneath with a tall middle band and a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight.
